heroSubtitle: Reunite, Celebrate, and Ignite the Future of IEM Alumni
whoWeAreDescription: The IEM - HCMIU Alumni Association is a community that brings together graduates of the IEM Faculty at HCMIU. It was founded on the principles of connection and mutual support among alumni.
founderHaName: Mr. Le Chi Ha - ISE K09, President of the IEM - HCMIU Alumni Association
founderHoaQuote: “For me, IEM Alumni is a second home for alumni.”
founderHoaName: Ms. Nguyen Le Minh Hoa - ISE K17, member of the IEM - HCMIU Alumni Association Executive Committee
connectDescription: Build lasting relationships between IEM alumni across generations, industries, and countries through reunions and community events.
supportDescription: Mentor current students, share career opportunities, and help fellow alumni grow professionally and personally.
celebrateDescription: Honor the achievements of our community and keep the IEM spirit alive with annual gatherings such as WIEMA.
galleryDescription: Moments from our reunions, events and everyday community life.
